name: cordier_specific_speed
title: Cordier specific-speed line and 0D efficiency pre-design of turbomachines (function library)
summary: Five EES FUNCTION/PROCEDURE blocks of the LaboThapPy 0D turbomachinery sizing: specific speed omega_s, specific diameter from the tabulated Cordier line (clamped or linearly extended), rotor diameter, machine-type zone from 2733*omega_s, the pump head, and a bilinear pump-efficiency estimate on a (volume flow, omega_s) chart with band limits. The demonstration program re-runs the pump, compressor and turbine sizing cases and the radial-pump design example of LaboThapPy (cyclopentane and CO2).

authors: Basile Chaudoir (LaboThapPy, ULiege; author of all five translated files in the repository history)
origin.license: Apache-2.0 (original, LICENSE.txt of LaboThapPy); translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT licence (decision D3)
origin.notes: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47 (files above, last commits c81a2f14 and 9c8498ff, 2025-2026). The Cordier line (specific diameter versus specific speed) is the classical diagram of O. Cordier (1955); the 19 tabulated points and the 8 x 17 efficiency chart are those embedded in the LaboThapPy code, whose own source is not stated there (not checked against Cordier's diagram or any chart). Inventory rows LTP-053 (kept) and LTP-065 (duplicate of LTP-053).

verification.summary: The LaboThapPy functions and the radial-pump design example were re-run (CoolProp 8.0.0) with the same inputs: 112 common variables (specific speeds, diameters, zones, densities, efficiencies, powers) agree, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max 4.27e-09. The three data tables were checked against the source functions at all nodes.
verification.reference: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47 re-run in a throw-away virtual environment under work/: pump_0D_design, turbine_0D_design and compressor_0D_design (their function bodies, case inputs of the scripts), pump_efficiency_0D_estimation (13 argument sets) and RadialPumpODDesign.Omega_system on four cells of the main example (R744, 500 kg/s)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --all: 112 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), max 4.27e-09 (W_dot_rp and W_dot_shaft_rp, differences of enthalpies); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 123 (inputs, intermediate and unit-converted values). Reference CoolProp 8.0.0, CoolSolve CoolProp 8.1.0dev (revision 75af781): same HEOS fluid models, agreement at round-off. The Python NaN of the efficiency estimate is -1 in both. No published value was checked: the Cordier line and the efficiency chart are taken from the source code.
